$comment: MASTER LIST of every metric created for BAR replay analysis. One entry per metric. The process (process/run.mjs) executes metrics by `id`. Add new metrics with process/addMetric.mjs (never hand-edit unless you know the shape). granularity: team-per-time | team-final | player | global. 'module' is resolved relative to process/lib/metrics/.

metrics.title: Self-reclaim — cumulative value of own units reclaimed, by category, per team

value.note: same formula as economy_composition: metalCost + energyCost/70 per unit

detection.note: weaponDefID -12 is Spring/Recoil's internal constant for the reclaim action. 6 enemy-reclaim events also have wid=-12 but different attackerTeam — excluded. Commander (if reclaimed) double-counted into build_power + military.

categories.economy: reclaimed economy structures (solars, mexes, wind, fusors, etc.)
categories.military: reclaimed living combat units (liquidating a unit for metal)
categories.build_power: reclaimed constructor units or construction turrets

outputs: per-team cumulative self-reclaim time series, split by bucket

metrics.title: Economy composition — % of total value by category, per team, per time

build_power.desc: worker units (T1 corca/corck/corcv/armca/armck/armcv, butlers/consuls, T2 builders), construction turrets, and the commander's build contribution

economy.desc: energy producers + converters + resource storage buildings + metal extractors

infrastructure.desc: factories / labs / plants (anything that builds mobile units)

military.desc: combat units, static defenses, radar/jammer; the commander is double-counted here at a flat 1200 value

storage.desc: resources currently sitting in storage (NOT unit value): metalCurrent + energyCurrent/70 from extra_stat_update

other.desc: fallback bucket for any unit not matched above

commander.note: commander value (1200) is added to BOTH build_power and military; the denominator includes both copies so per-category percentages still sum to 100%
